# neo4jaura_organization_invite (Resource)

Invites a user to an Aura organization by email, optionally granting project roles at the same time.

-> **Note:** The Aura API has no endpoint to edit a pending invite. Any change to `email`, `organization_roles`, or `project_invites` will revoke the existing invite and create a new one.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The email address of the invitee.
- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization to invite the user to.
- `organization_roles` (List of String) The organization roles to grant the invitee. Possible values: `organization-owner`, `organization-admin`, `organization-member`.

### Optional

- `project_invites` (Attributes List) Project roles to grant the invitee at the same time, alongside the organization role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--project_invites))

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) The timestamp after which the invite can no longer be accepted.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the invite.
- `invited_by` (String) The ID of the user who created the invite.
- `status` (String) The status of the invite. Possible values: `active`, `accepted`, `revoked`, `expired`, `declined`.

<a id="nestedatt--project_invites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `project_invites`

Required:

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project to grant roles in.
- `project_roles` (List of String) The project roles to grant. Possible values: `namespace-viewer`, `namespace-member`, `namespace-admin`, `namespace-metrics-integration-reader`.
